verdict.rationale: A data-use policy that excludes customer data from AI model training is a fair privacy question for any SaaS platform that processes customer data, including a payments platform with AI-agent tooling, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training data use, an opt-out control, or a no-training commitment. The pack covers only payments, wallets, webhooks, the sandbox, and MCP/CLI tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
